note: Superior National Forest (Kawishiwi district) campground on 130-acre Fenske Lake, about 10 miles north of Ely on the Echo Trail. Widely spaced sites on one large loop under tall pines; some overlook the lake through the trees. Grassy swimming beach, boat ramp, accessible fishing pier, log picnic shelter and a 1-mile nature trail; the lake is on a canoe circle route near Boundary Waters entry points. The group site sits apart on a rock ledge above the lake. No ATVs. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 233840 read: 10 RV sites (6 reservable, 4 FCFS; 20-44 ft, one 80 ft) + 5 walk-to tent + group, $22 / group $65 (2027-28 same), nonelectric, vault toilets + water, 14 nights, 9 people. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (canopy, 50 m+). Season May 8-Oct 31 written (no fees after late Sept). Phone missing.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (defaults down; no waterfront_evidence, no --AWH value). rec.gov/FS: 'All sites have partial to full shade, and some overlook the lake'. On imagery the loop runs south of the lake through continuous canopy. The RV sites nearest the water are 012 (47.99587,-91.91407; pad on a spur east of the road), about 50-60 m from the shore through trees, and 013/014/015 (47.9965-47.9967,-91.9158 to -91.9163), about 70-80 m from the west lobe. Walk-to tent sites 010/011 (47.9953-47.9955,-91.9134 to -91.9136) are about 50 m back under trees. The open ground at the water is the day-use beach, boat ramp and fishing pier (about 47.9975,-91.9135). No RV site on open ground within 50 m, so not lakefront. The group site 016 'perched high on a rock ledge overlooking the lake' (47.99865,-91.91646) is a group site, not a nightly single.

FIT: rec.gov back-in RV/Trailer limits 32-44 ft on most sites, 80 on 002, 20 ft on 013 and 014; FS 'most sites do not accommodate large RVs'. A 23-ft rig fits eight sites. max_rig_ft 80 kept as the catalog maximum; sites.note gives the spread.
